body:
Current requirement:

| # | Description | L1 | L2 | L3 | CWE |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **[5.5.4](https://appsecg.host/5.5)** | Verify that when parsing JSON in browsers or JavaScript-based backends, JSON.parse is used to parse the JSON document. Do not use eval() to parse JSON. | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | 95 |

This requirement should be removed as a duplicate. Parsing JSON is a general problem which I think is adequately covered elsewhere and eval is covered in [5.2.4](https://appsecg.host/5.2):

| # | Description | L1 | L2 | L3 | CWE |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **5.2.4** | Verify that the application avoids the use of eval() or other dynamic code execution features. Where there is no alternative, any user input being included must be sanitized or sandboxed before being executed. | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | 95 |

JSON injection is covered elsewhere and I think the deserialization aspects are covered in other requirements in this section.

comments.body: This is more of a legacy issue and I'm ok with it being removed.
